searchText: <@!393119312350543872> I'm using retesteth to generate custom set of state tests? Is there a way not to be fixed to predefined dir structure? `stExample`, `stAttackTest`, etc? https://ethereum-tests.readthedocs.io/en/latest/retesteth-ref.html?highlight=testfile#setting-the-test-suite-and-test There is an option --testfile But thats only 1 file Since we use boost, the test folders are hardcoded So `-t GeneralStateTests -- --filltests --testfile mytestFiller.yml`? Ok, I have found an example so I will try to use it. Single file is fine because I'm using Makefile for it anyway.
